description: Dia 1.6B (0626) — multi-speaker dialogue TTS with non-verbal sounds

notes: Dia Transformers backend is CUDA-only in Vox; CPU, ONNX, and Spark/ARM NVIDIA paths are not currently production-supported.
Vox budgets the adapter's 10GB model estimate plus configured VRAM headroom; deployments capped at 10GiB with 1GiB headroom will reject Dia at load time.
